learning_outcomes.text: Record and read a macro in the Visual Basic Editor
Navigate the Excel object model (Application, Workbook, Worksheet, Range)
Use variables, branching and loops in procedures
Write Sub and Function procedures with parameters
Handle errors and structure macros for maintainability

integrative_case: An analyst automates a weekly report: record a first draft, refactor it to loop over a variable number of rows, split logic into reusable procedures, add error handling so a missing file does not crash the run, and save the workbook as a macro-enabled file for colleagues.
